matches.rationale: No finding says the 128-byte account storage overhead is missing from MIN_DEPOSIT_LAMPORTS. Finding 7 is about the Solana side having no minimum check, and finding 19 is about a comment and the discriminator, so neither is this defect.
Finding 2 says deposit takes the bump as a user-supplied argument and stores it instead of using ctx.bumps. Finding 3 reports the same defect in withdraw.
No finding says MessageSent emits the Ethereum chain id as the destination.
No finding covers truncation of msg! logs.
Finding 1 blames predictable block-property randomness. The reference defect is the 64-bit width and the missing check for nonce reuse, which is a different root cause.
No finding covers addressArrayInitialized accepting an empty array.
No finding covers the relayer holding custody of bridged funds.
No finding mentions the missing _disableInitializers call.
No finding covers using invoke_signed where invoke would do.
Finding 11 identifies the oversized 1024-byte WithdrawalReceipt allocation. Finding 12 covers Configuration, but each reference finding can match only one report finding.
